development.validation: fixed three-fold StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by Origin_program; historical frozen test excluded

grouped_cv_at_threshold_0_5.selection_status: retained; no tested full-development model materially outperformed it

oof_metrics_at_selected_threshold.estimate: descriptive development selection estimate, not unbiased evaluation

model_comparisons.name: Extra Trees, no class weights
model_comparisons.decision: no material difference from selected model

feature_screen_macro_f1.scope: 60-tree screen on representative 200k selection; not directly comparable to full-development baseline

selector_screen_macro_f1.scope: same three grouped validation folds; subset screen

threshold_selection.objective: macro F1 on a 0.005 grid; leave-one-development-fold-out nested threshold checks also performed
threshold_selection.limitation: final 0.485 was selected from all development OOF predictions, so its pooled OOF score is selection-biased

frozen_test: not used in new experiments; earlier examination means it remains exploratory
